description: This file defines TypeScript enums, interfaces, and classes related to user management, workspace sharing, login activities, and schema validation schemas for organization setup and user registration in a software project.

classes.name: IUser
classes.description: Represents a user with properties like id, email, name, credentials, status, tokens, roles, and last login info.

methods.name: OrgSetupSchema
methods.description: Zod schema for validating organization setup form data, including organization name, username, email, password, and password confirmation.

methods.name: RegisterUserSchema
methods.description: Zod schema for validating user registration form data, including username, email, password, password confirmation, and invite token.
